title: Continuity — motion design, as code (litt look)
logline: For design engineers and motion designers meeting the litt look for the first time: motion design written as code, every frame of it checked (precise, quiet, provable), ending on one action, Get started.

scenes.intent: Stake the promise in one calm line: motion design is written as code.

beats.note: five words rise on snappy: the scene's expressive moment
the file behind this frame types on in mono

elements.note: Headline line 1, text-display (168px), fg, left edge of the safe area. Lower-left composition: the lit top edge stays empty.
Headline line 2, same size and edge, directly under l1. One colour (fg): no word is picked out.
Mono (Geist Mono) text-caption (30px), text-subtle, left edge, ~40px under l2. It names this very scene's source file (scenes/hook.tsx). The only label in the film; no eyebrow.

scenes.motion: Backdrop `lit` (default), static. Camera locked: no m.camera, no m.loop (the light must not move). b1 (0.1): m.enter(['l1','l2'], 'rise', { at: 'b1', split: 'words', stagger: 'word', distance: 32, duration: 'slow', ease: 'snappy' }): five words, 60ms apart, landed by ~1.0s. This is the scene's ONE expressive moment (snappy, bounce ~0.13); nothing else here uses a spring. b2 (1.2): m.type('file', { at: 'b2', cps: 36 }), ends ~1.45s: ambient life from content, no caret, no accent. Then ~1.1s of stillness. Nothing exits: the crossfade (starts 2.6s) is the exit.

scenes.intent: Prove the claim: a gate checks every frame, and a findings list resolves to 0 errors.

beats.note: findings card rises; rows fade in 0.2s later (red, red, amber)
the fix: three status dots flip to green, one after another
'0 errors' verdict pill pops: the expressive moment; cut follows after a ~0.9s hold

elements.note: Headline line 1, text-h1 (120px), fg, left edge. Sits in rows 2-3, above the hook's text band, so the crossfade never overlays text on text.
Headline line 2, directly under l1.
<Card> ~840px wide, top edge aligned with l1. No glow, no glass: it reads by border and surface. Holds `findings` and `verdict`.
<List> of 3 rows (findings-r0..r2). Titles = text.f0..f2 (sans 28px, fg); meta = text.t0..t2 (mono, subtle: the time stamps). Status dots: danger, danger, warning.
Positive ring dot laid exactly over row 0's status dot, opacity 0. State layer for the flip (no colour channel: cross-fade).
Same, row 1.
Same, row 2.

<Pill dot="positive"> at the card's bottom-left under the list, ~28px below the last row; enlarged on purpose (class h-[68px] text-[32px] text-fg) because it is the payoff. It is a verdict, not an action: no accent fill, no glow.

scenes.motion: Backdrop `lit`, static; camera locked. b1 (0.3): m.enter(['l1','l2'], 'rise', { at: 'b1', split: 'words', stagger: 'word', distance: 32, duration: 'base', ease: 'standard' }), landed ~0.8s. b2 (0.6): card `rise` (base, standard, 32), then at b2+0.2 the rows as one array with `fade` (base, stagger 'grid') so they land ~1.3s showing the failing state; keep the red state still for >= 1.0s (that is the read). b3 (2.3): the fix: ok0..ok2 `fade` in over the status dots (fast, stagger 'grid', ~2.65s done); nothing else moves (no strike-through, no colour tween). b4 (2.7): verdict `scalePop` (snappy at slow), the scene's ONE expressive moment, landed ~3.3s; hold >= 0.9s. The cut is on the beat after the hold. No exits. No accent fill and no shadow-glow in this scene.

scenes.intent: Proof in numbers: three stable facts in mono; the last one, 0, is the point.

beats.note: the 0 pops: the expressive moment, then the longest hold

elements.note: text-lead (48px), text-muted, left edge. Quiet on purpose: the figures are the hero (120px : 48px = 2.5x).
<Stat value={5}> from text.axes: Geist Mono figure at text-h1 (120px), fg. Label `axes-label` = text.axes-label (30px, muted).
<Stat value={30}> from text.fps; label `fps-label`.
<Stat value={0}> from text.errors; label `errors-label`. Same size and colour as the others: the pop, not the size, makes it the point.

scenes.motion: Cut in on the beat. Backdrop `lit`, static; camera locked. b1 (0.1): lead `rise` (base, standard, 32). b2 (0.2): m.enter(['axes','fps'], 'rise', { stagger: 'grid', distance: 32, duration: 'base', ease: 'standard' }); m.counter('axes', { from: 0, to: 5, at: 'b2', duration: 'slow' }); m.counter('fps', { from: 0, to: 30, at: 'b2+0.05', duration: 'slow' }); labels `fade` (opacity only) at b2+0.15. Figures stay in Geist Mono (Stat default): no weight or width tween. b3 (1.1): 'errors' `scalePop` (snappy at slow), the scene's ONE expressive moment; 'errors-label' `fade` at b3+0.2. The 0 has nothing to count from, so it pops. Then hold >= 1.3s (the key stat's read); the dip is the exit, nothing leaves earlier. No accent fill, no glow.

scenes.intent: Name it and ask for one action: Continuity, Motion design, as code., Get started beside npx ct init.

beats.note: wordmark rises as the dip clears
Get started pops with its glow ring: the expressive moment and the one primary action
the command chip fades in and types npx ct init

elements.note: text-display (168px) in the litt display role, fg, centred. The film's only centred frame. Plain text, no logo mark, no picked-out letter.
text-lead (48px), text-muted, centred under the wordmark (168px : 48px = 3.5x).
<Button variant="primary" class="shadow-glow"> 'Get started', 76px high, left of the chip. The only accent fill and the only shadow-glow in the film. No arrow glyph.
Command chip, same 76px height as the button, 24px gap: bg-surface-2, 1px border, rounded-control, Geist Mono 30px, text-fg. No accent, no glow. Row [cta | cmd] centred as one unit.
The typed string, text.cmd, inside the chip.
Thin caret after the text in text-fg / bg-fg. NOT accent (the button holds the only accent).

scenes.motion: Backdrop `lit`, static; camera locked. The dip's second half brings the scene up; first motion at b1 (0.4). b1: wordmark `rise` (base, standard, 32). b2 (0.7): tagline `rise` (base, standard, 32). b3 (1.0): cta `scalePop` (snappy at slow): the scene's ONE expressive moment. The glow is the Button's own shadow-glow and never animates (no brightness, pulse or loop on it). b4 (1.4): cmd `fade` (base), then m.type('cmd-text', { at: 1.5, cps: 26 }) ends ~1.9s; m.blink('cmd-caret', { at: 1.95, until: 'end-0.3' }) is the ambient life from content. Hold >= 1.5s after the last element lands. No exit: the film ends on the held card.
